title: 第25章 女帝心思缜密第26章 温家大小姐来援
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
“夜儿这般体质要是传出去，怕是会被邪魔异族间谍盯上，毕竟诸天中还隐藏着一些，小型裂缝的空间通道……你们就说答不答应吧？”
随着苏红夜话音落下。
两位大帝瞬息间，无数念头通达。
其实，只要是能治好他们身上的邪魔炁气。
别说姜族独霸诸天了，就算其他道统全部死绝，他们都不会有丝毫意见。
两位大帝也不再作扭捏，表明态度：
“可以，不过我有一个条件，这位神子殿下须立下天道誓言。”
“不错，不能空头支票！”
苏红夜脸色阴沉下来。
这场交易本就够宽容了，这两条老狗还想讲条件？
“尔等得了便宜还卖乖是吧？”
“今日若非是你二人，本帝根本不会透露此事！”
苏红夜脸色冰冷如霜，语气漠然。
这时姜夜站了出来，安抚道：“没事娘，立个天道誓言而已，不算什么。”
他知晓自家母亲的打算。
无非是让自己打打配合，笼络人心而已。
至于天道誓言？
不好意思。
他有天命大反派光环，无视任何天道反噬。
若是今后这两位大帝不听话，就别想被治疗了。

“两位前辈，小辈斗胆说两句废话。”
“家母今日肯与二位交涉结盟，实是念在父亲昔日与两位的交情…”
“还望两位前辈，严守契约，将关于天机大帝的一切线索和情报，尽数详告于我们。”
“包括之后围杀天机大帝…”
“若是往后两位前辈敢违约，或者打酱油不出力，那这疗伤之事…也就到此为止了。”
玄黄大帝与破虚大帝对视一眼，心中略有波动。
片刻后，终是默然点头应下。
只要有了保证。
剩余条件似乎也无关紧要。
玄黄大帝思索一番，旋即又沉声道：“女帝，最后一点，我们结盟的事情暂时不能对外公开……以免剩余几位大帝狗急跳墙，疯狂反扑，到时恐怕就不好收场了！”
“没问题，不过还是与之前一样，立下天道反噬誓言，用秘法契约作担保！”
两位大帝没有再犹豫，立刻同意。
“可！”
“善也！”
content_en:
"If word spreads about Ye'er's physique, I'm afraid he will be targeted by evil alien spies. After all, there are still some space passages with small cracks hidden in the heavens... Just tell me whether you agree or not?"
As Su Hongye finished speaking.
In an instant, the two great emperors had countless thoughts.
In fact, as long as it can cure the evil spirit in them.
Not to mention that the Jiang clan dominates the heavens, even if all other traditions are dead, they will not have the slightest objection.
The two great emperors no longer hesitated and expressed their attitudes:
"Yes, but I have a condition. His Highness the Son of God must take an oath of heaven."
"That's right, you can't make a blank promise!"
Su Hongye's face darkened.
This deal is already tolerant enough, but these two old dogs still want to negotiate terms?
"You've got a bargain, so you're good, right?"
"If it weren't for you and me today, I wouldn't have revealed this matter at all!"
Su Hongye's face was as cold as frost and her tone was indifferent.
At this time Jiang Ye stood up and said comfortingly: "It's okay, mother, it's just an oath to heaven, it's nothing."
He knew his mother's plan.
It's nothing more than letting yourself cooperate and win over people's hearts.
As for the oath of heaven?
Excuse me.
He has the aura of a destined villain and ignores any counterattack from heaven.
If these two great emperors disobey in the future, there will be no hope of being treated.
"Two seniors, the junior dared to say a few nonsense words."
"My mother is willing to negotiate and form an alliance with you two today because she is thinking of my father's friendship with you two in the past..."
"We also hope that the two seniors will strictly abide by the contract and tell us all the clues and information about Emperor Tianji in detail."
"Including the subsequent siege and killing of Emperor Tianji..."
"If the two seniors dare to break the contract in the future, or fail to contribute, then this healing thing...will stop here."
Emperor Xuanhuang and Emperor Poxu looked at each other with slight fluctuations in their hearts.
After a moment, he finally nodded silently in agreement.
As long as there is a guarantee.
The remaining conditions don't seem to matter either.
Emperor Xuanhuang thought for a while, then said in a deep voice: "Empress, one last point, our alliance cannot be disclosed to the public for the time being... lest the remaining emperors jump over the wall and counterattack madly, it may not end well!"
"No problem, but it's still the same as before, making an oath of heaven's counterattack and using the secret contract as a guarantee!"
The two emperors agreed immediately without any further hesitation.
"Yes!"
"Son Ye!"
